priceNote: Self-fetched (Yahoo chart API, Nov 18, 2026 intraday): $276.95 (+1.5%). Down from $298.70 on Nov 11 and ~25% below the $368.89 high (Oct 9, 2026); 1-year low $121.11 (Apr 10). summary: Snowflake reports Q3 FY27 on Dec 2 (company release) coming off three straight quarters of accelerating product revenue (+37% to $1.49B in Q2). The stock is ~25% off its October high on sector de-rating, not company news. Consensus is wide — Barchart's ~$342 average implies +23.5% and Benzinga's $402 implies +45% (Evercore $430). The gate clears on the conservative figure. The risk is the opposite of CRM's: SNOW is priced for growth (forward P/E ~121x), so a merely in-line product-revenue guide can sell off (Dec 2025: -8% despite a beat). Core at-catalyst median -6.5% (n=157) → Entry 2 preferred. Base +14% is a ~2-week horizon, above the 14d P75 (+10.8%) because the Nov 21, 2024 precedent was +32%. แนะนำ 4–6% ของ capital เท่านั้น.

catalysts.name: Q3 FY2027 earnings — product revenue growth + Q4 guide
catalysts.description: Confirmed for Wednesday Dec 2, 2026 after the close (company press release, Nov 2). The market watches product revenue growth (37% in Q2), net revenue retention, and the product gross margin (guide cut to 74% from 75% on AI costs).

catalysts.name: Cortex AI / agent consumption ramp
catalysts.description: AI workloads (Cortex, Cortex Code agents) are the acceleration driver and the reason gross margin guidance was trimmed. Any disclosed AI revenue run-rate on the call is the swing factor for the multiple.

risks: Priced for growth: ~121x forward P/E after the drop. An in-line product-revenue guide can trigger a sell-off even on a beat (Dec 2025: -8%).
AI costs: management already cut the product gross margin outlook to 74% from 75%. Further compression would undercut the AI-monetization story.
Sector beta: SNOW fell 7.2% on Nov 5 and ~13% in the week to Nov 2 with no company news — the AI-capex/software narrative can overwhelm the print.
Consensus dispersion ($292–$427 across sources) means the +20% gate depends on which average you use; the conservative ~$342 clears by only ~3pp.
Macro is WAIT (30/100) with VIX ~23–26; long-duration growth multiples are the most rate-sensitive part of software.

estimateDates.note: Product revenue growth vs 37% in Q2

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) lands a week before the print.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: High-multiple, long-duration software is the most rate-sensitive part of tech. A hawkish Dec 9 FOMC a week after the print can cap any post-earnings rally.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the print dominates, but a WAIT macro tape (30/100) and a hike a week later argue for a dip entry and partial profit-taking at TP1.

entryStrategy.verdict: BUY (Speculative) — accelerating product revenue into a confirmed Dec 2 print after a ~25% sector de-rating. The measured core at-catalyst median is -6.5% with 65% of picks underwater at their event, so report price is not the default entry: Entry 2 ($258–268) is preferred. Take partial profits at TP1 before the Dec 9 FOMC.

catalystSpot.preRunup: No run-up: the stock has de-rated ~25% from its October high into the print on sector fears, so the bar is lower than the multiple suggests.

postWin.note: SNOW jumped ~32% on Nov 21, 2024 after a Q3 FY25 beat and raised guide. A beat from a de-rated base can move far more than the core 14d P75.

postLose.note: SNOW fell ~8% in Dec 2025 as product revenue growth slowed despite a revenue beat.

spotSizing.reason: 5% (spot). earnings_beat sits at +4.2pp medianExcess vs +4.1pp overall (n=89) — neutral. High multiple + WAIT macro tape → mid-low sizing, scaled in.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the earnings_beat medianMAE (-9.5%). Below ~$238 before the print, the sector is still de-rating — step aside.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If product revenue growth decelerates below ~33% or the guide is light, exit on day 1 — Dec 2025 is the template.
